policy: Editorial fan-favorite rarity informed by official honors and team recognition; not an objective popularity ranking or fan-vote result.
selection: Choose a player with probability equal to their rarity weight divided by the sum of all player weights, conditional on a sticker drop. Overall entropy-based drop chance is unchanged.

default_rule.uncommon_basis: At least 150 Rangers NHL regular-season appearances in any single recorded role, after overrides. An editorial service-length seed, not a popularity metric. Do not add mixed-role GP.

override_precedence: Explicit NHL player-ID overrides take precedence over the appearance-based seed.
